tap_ok.description: Tapping the cell writes the fixed text "OK" (used later for stamps; Lager rows use tap_row_cover instead).

manual_text.description: Opens the keyboard for free manual text/number entry into the cell.

tap_x.description: On tap, write "X" into the cell (checkbox-style mark).

tap_date_settings.description: On tap/press, write today's date in format DD.MM.YY (e.g. 15.09.26). Default date is today but user can set a different working date in settings.

tap_initials_stamp.description: On tap/press, stamp configured user initials into the cell.

scan_or_manual.description: Tapping the cell opens the camera for DataMatrix or 1D barcode; decoded value is written into the cell. Manual numeric/text entry is also allowed.

manual_date.description: Manual date entry into the cell (datepicker or typed date).

removed.description: Field deleted — not an interactive input.

tap_row_cover.description: Tapping the row covers it with 50% white and strokes the Bedarf Stck cell in black. Tap again clears. No OK/stamp text.

tap_gebucht.description: Invisible bottom-of-page tap writes „gebucht am {TT.MM.JJ} von {initials}“ using settings stamp date + initials. Tap again clears. No blue highlight, no row whitewash.

bedarf_column.detected_from: page 1 header text Bedarf/Stck + vertical rules
